titulo: GTA 6 Was Never Going to Hit 60 Frames per Second on Consoles
texto: Back when Rockstar showed off a bunch of GTA 6 gameplay on Netflix, one thing was incredibly clear – the game was running around 30 fps. And now that Rockstar has confirmed that it is targeting 30 fps on every console, including the PS5 Pro, it's clear that the game likely never would have run at a solid 60 on console.

titulo: GTA 6: What Will Review Scores Be? You Can Win A $500 Gift Card For Getting It Right
texto: Rockstar's long-awaited open-world action game Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and among the many things people are excited to find out is how the game will score with reviewers. Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is currently the No. 1 most highly rated game of 2026 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic , but could GTA 6 dethrone it? You can make a prediction of your own via GameSpot's parent company, Fandom, and score a chance to win a gift card for up to $500. Make your pick. Now through midnight on November 17, you can submit your prediction for GTA 6's score on Metacritic by dragging the slider on the GTA 6 Metascore Prediction page . Selections are editable up until the contest closes. There are three prizes up for grabs in the form of Visa gift cards. The first-place prize is a $500 gift card, with $250 going to second place, and $150 for third
